Metrics and recommendations for Copilot Studio
Feedback
Summarize this article for me
Copilot Studio operational health metrics are available in the Power Platform admin center.
View Copilot Studio metrics
Sign in to the
Power Platform admin center
.
In the navigation pane, select
Monitor
.
In the
Monitor
pane, under
Products
, select
Copilot Studio
.
The
Copilot Studio
page displays the metrics for conversational and autonomous agents created in Copilot Studio. For agents that use GitHub Copilot, Copilot Studio uses AI to review each completed session and assign it a single outcome, such as resolved, escalated, or abandoned. Monitor then uses that outcome to decide whether the session counts as a success or a failure. The AI analysis runs after the session ends, so metrics for these agents can appear in Monitor up to 48 hours after usage.
Copilot Studio metrics and recommendations
Metric definitions
Type
Metric
Definition
Support

Agent session success rate
A percentage that describes how often an autonomous agent is able to successfully execute its task, or how often a conversational agent's session was successfully resolved.
Generally available
Agents
Recent agent sessions
The number of distinct user sessions in an agent in one day. A session begins when a user opens the agent and ends after a period of inactivity or when the agent is closed.
Generally available

How the success rate is calculated
Monitor calculates the success rate only from sessions that have an outcome:

Each session is counted once.
This mapping applies to conversational sessions for agents that use GitHub Copilot. Autonomous agents continue to report success based on whether each run completed its task.
Tips for improving your success rate
Many "Unresolved" or "Escalated â user requested" outcomes:
Check that the agent has the knowledge sources and instructions it needs to answer common questions.
Many "Escalated â system unintended" outcomes:
Look for failing tools, connectors, or flows that the agent calls.
Many "Abandoned" outcomes:
Review session transcripts to see where users drop off, for example after long responses or repeated clarifying questions.
